lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 8 — The Church Persecuted / Philip and the Ethiopian

questions.questionText: I approved of Stephen being killed. Who am I?
What broke out against the church in Jerusalem that day?
Where were the believers scattered?
Who buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him?
Who began to destroy the church, dragging off men and women to prison?
What did those who were scattered do?
options: They preached the word wherever they went

questions.questionText: Where did Philip go and proclaim the Messiah?
How did the crowds respond to Philip?
options: They paid close attention to what he said

questions.questionText: I practiced sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria. Who am I?
What did people say about Simon?
options: “This man is rightly called the Great Power of God.”

questions.questionText: When the people believed Philip, what did they do?
options: They were baptized, both men and women

questions.questionText: True or false: Simon himself believed and was baptized.
options: True — but he became an apostle that day

questions.questionText: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard Samaria accepted the word, whom did they send?
What did Peter and John do for the new believers?
options: They prayed that they might receive the Holy Spirit and laid hands on them

questions.questionText: What did Simon offer the apostles?
options: Money for the power to give the Spirit

questions.questionText: Who said, “May your money perish with you”?
Peter told Simon to do what?
options: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord

questions.questionText: Who said, “Pray to the Lord for me”?
Who told Philip to go south to the desert road?
I am an important official in charge of the treasury of the Kandake, queen of the Ethiopians. Who am I?
Where had the Ethiopian gone?
What was the Ethiopian reading in his chariot?
options: The Book of Isaiah the prophet

questions.questionText: Who told Philip, “Go to that chariot and stay near it”?
Philip asked, “Do you understand what you are reading?” Who answered, “How can I unless someone explains it?”
The passage he read was about whom being led like a sheep to the slaughter?
options: Jesus, as Philip explained from Isaiah

questions.questionText: What did the eunuch say when they came to some water?
options: “Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?”

questions.questionText: What did Philip do?
options: He went to Ethiopia that day

questions.questionText: What happened to Philip when they came up out of the water?
options: The Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away
He rode in the chariot to Ethiopia

questions.questionText: Where did Philip appear and keep preaching?
options: Azotus, then all the towns until Caesarea

questions.questionText: The desert road went down from Jerusalem to where?
I am queen of the Ethiopians, also called Kandake. Who am I?
True or false: The apostles stayed in Jerusalem during the persecution.
options: True — all except the apostles were scattered
True — but Saul stayed with the church

questions.questionText: Who proclaimed the Messiah in Samaria?
Peter told Simon his heart was not right before God. What else did he say Simon was full of?
I invited Philip to sit with me in my chariot. Who am I?
After being baptized, how did the eunuch go on his way?
Philip reached which city after Azotus?
Who performed signs in Samaria including impure spirits coming out and the paralyzed and lame being healed?
True or false: There was great joy in that city of Samaria.
I thought I could buy the gift of God with money. Who am I?
